why_essential: The citizen science annotations are the input points DBSCAN will cluster; the script must load them to run clustering and evaluation.
Expert annotations are the ground truth used to compute F1 and average delta for each image; they are required for evaluation and averaging across images.
Parallelization speeds up the grid search over the large hyperparameter space and was used to evaluate combinations concurrently.
Pareto-analysis is required to identify Pareto-optimal hyperparameter combinations balancing F1 and delta after filtering results.
DBSCAN must use a custom distance metric parameterized by shape_weight (w); this skill provides the needed custom metric implementation.

core_step: Write the optimization script to /root/optimize_dbscan.py implementing the grid search, custom DBSCAN metric, per-image evaluation, filtering (F1>0.5) and Pareto identification
why_essential: A script is required to systematically run DBSCAN across the specified hyperparameter grid, compute per-image and aggregated metrics, filter results, and produce the final Pareto frontier CSV.
Running the script performs the grid search, evaluates combinations, applies the F1>0.5 filter, and computes the Pareto frontier, producing the required output file.
The task requires the Pareto frontier to be written to /root/pareto_frontier.csv in the specified CSV format for downstream use.
